questions.text: In the MVP every request is staff and every permission is granted. Is it acceptable that the patient count and list are effectively open to any caller until sign-in arrives, or must this change wait for real access control?

rubric_items.reason: Both design components, PatientsPage and the GET /api/patients list handler, have threats. The endpoint entry in the design is the same handler.
T-1 (confirming a person is a patient) and T-3 (per-keystroke load) fit this change. T-2 is about a response extension that the design rules out, so it adds little.
All mitigations cite controls. But T-1 relies on requirePermission, which grants every permission in the MVP, so in practice it controls nothing today.
Assumed, unknown and questions are all empty, yet T-1 depends on access control that does not exist in the MVP. That gap is presented as known instead of being raised.
Short and readable, with matching frontmatter and body. Threats are listed by id, not ordered by risk.
